title: Dallas Willard - A Heartfelt Word to Pastors and Leaders

playlist.playlist_description:
In January of 2001, some of the pastors from the west valley of Los Angeles began gathering to pray for the city and the churches that make up the whole Church in the San Fernando valley. It was their commitment from the beginning to pray, to develop relationships with one another, and to wait on the Lord to show them what He had in mind for them to do. He led them to minister together in the neighborhoods where those in our churches live. This ministry has become known as Neighborhood Initiative.

Resources are available for pastors and leaders interested in implementing their own neighborhood initiative in their cities. Visit https://neighborhoodinitiative.com
